infra.primary.sqlite.description: SQLite-dialect Primary Database providers — a future non-SQLite dialect (e.g. Postgres) would be a sibling layer under infra/primary, not a member here

sqlite.description: D1 runtime database, D1 deployment resource, and memory database are independent doors built on separate private schema and migration modules.

infra.secondary.description: Session Store providers — interchangeable backends for the same decision

secondary.description: The Cloudflare KV runtime store, its Alchemy resource, and the memory store are independent public capabilities.

worker.description: Public — createAuthWorker(config): assembles the better-auth config (Cookie Cache TTL, a Google OAuth plugin, Trusted Origin and Shared Cookie Domain settings) over an already-built Primary Database and Session Store. Takes no dependency on infra — the consumer imports a provider from infra/primary/* and infra/secondary/* and passes it in, so a worker.instance built for tests can swap in the memory providers without this layer knowing. The consumer's own Worker entrypoint calls createAuthWorker and exports the result — that host root lives in the consumer's app, not in this package.

client.description: Public — Direct Session Check: React hooks for session state, sign-in, and sign-out

server.description: Public — Server-Side Verification: forwards a Consumer Backend's request to the Auth Worker and returns a Verify Payload

auth-toolkit.description: Independently consumed doors — worker, client, server, and the infra providers each stand alone; the consumer wires providers into the worker itself, so no Layer here imports another.
